s: Seder qeriat hattora berosh hashshana ubo t' seipim: en omerim hallel berosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim, lepi shehaqqadosh baruk hu yosheb al kisse din vesipre chayyim vesipre metim petuchim lepanayv veek yomru shira. Veotam haomerim tehillim bekol yom veera lahem berosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim amirat hallel — muttarim lomar kedarkan, kevan sheen omerim otan derek shira raq derek techinna ubaqqasha:

Venohagim lomar "abinu malkenu" al hasseder. Veyesh shemmedallegin berosh hashshana "abinu malkenu chatanu lepaneka", lepi sheen omerim vidduy berosh hashshana shello litten pitchon peh lammeqatreg, abal lomar pesuqim sheyyesh bahen hazkarat chete — en qepeda, kevan sheeno derek vidduy. Vaapillu vidduy mammash en limnoa bishat hatteqiot shehassatan hu meurbab. Venakon haddabar lehitvaddot belachash ben hatteqiot beshaa shehatztzibbur omerim "yehi ratzon millepaneka veku'":
Tzarik lomar "selach umechal mecheh vehaaber chattotenu upeshaenu", ki mechila gedola misselicha upesha gadol mechattat, vetzarik lebaqqesh techilla al hammuat veachar kak mosip veholek:
Tzarik lomar "roa gezar" binshima achat, dehaynu sheyyiqra hu yitbarak haroa shebbaggezera, umah shennishar baggezera yihyeh lerachamim:
En omerim "abinu malkenu" beshabbat, mippene sheasur litboa tzerakayv beshabbat, vaapillu beereb shabbat bemincha en omerim oto:

Berosh hashshana maarikin bepiyyutim ubitpillot ad chatzot hayyom lekol happachot, veim chal beshabbat en lehaarik yoter mechatzot, abal bechol yakol lehaarik yoter. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bepiyyutim ubitpillot, abal beniggunim en lehaarik yoter mechatzot, kevan shehu yom tob:

Motziin shene sipre tora, barishon qorin chamishsha min "vaHashem paqad et sara" ad parashat haaqeda, lepi shebberosh hashshana nipqeda sara, veim hu shabbat qorin bo shiba, umaptir qore beseper tora sheni beparashat pinechas "ubachodesh hashshebii", umaptir bitchillat seper shemuel ad "veyarem qeren meshicho", lepi sheggam channa nipqeda berosh hashshana:
Veyesh meqomot shennohagim liqrot hattoqea mimminyan chamishsha haolim leseper tora. Veyesh meqomot nohagim liqrot gam hammitpallel musap, veken beyom hakkippurim:

Im yesh tinoq lamul berosh hashshana — en mamtinim lemulo ad achar gemar hattepilla, mishshum dizrizin maqdimin lemitzva, ella malin oto achar qeriat hattora qodem teqiat shopar, lepi sheal yede teqiat shopar haqqadosh baruk hu zoker aqedat yitzchaq tob lismok hammila berit abraham vaaqedat yitzchaq. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bemaqom shemmalin bebet hakkeneset, abal bemaqom shennohagim lamul kol echad bebeto — malin oto achar yetzia mibbet hakkeneset:
